issues.title: 6x compression claim is wrong: rank-128 SVD on [768,768] gives 3x param compression, not 6x
issues.detail: 768/128=6 is the rank reduction ratio, not parameter compression. Low-rank factors U[768,128]+V[128,768] = 196K params vs original 590K = 3.0x. Hypothesis thresholds (+5% PPL at '6x') are calibrated to the wrong compression ratio. Must choose: 6x params (rank ~64) or 3x params (rank 128), and recalibrate criteria accordingly.

notes: P5 null baseline text still references 'random V-projection + lstsq' but Step 4 now uses truncated SVD on all four attention matrices. Should update P5 to match.
